checks.name: definition exports id/version/metadata/defaultParams/paramsSchema/create
metadata declares illustrative-unverified content and unspecified jurisdiction
pre-ready seek is applied on readiness
determinism across ordered/reverse/shuffled/repeated seeks
scene state changes over time (not a static card)
renderFrame(n,{fps}) equals seek(n*1000/fps) at 24/30/60 fps; overshoot clamps
invalid dimensions/duration/fps/params/ids raise descriptive errors
setParams keeps absolute time and accepts a frozen patch (no mutation)
shortening duration clamps current time
resize recomputes layout and keeps scene time
getState() is serializable and includes transforms and bounds
presets × 16:9/9:16/1:1: no NaN, no forbidden/external elements, visible text inside frame and caption-safe area
backgrounds, locale es, label visibility, reduced motion, seeds and palettes render cleanly
textVisibility "none" hides all labels (action must read without them)
user text is inserted as text nodes (no markup injection)
two simultaneous instances: independent state and no duplicate SVG ids
destroy() is idempotent, removes its nodes, keeps other instances, and later calls raise
instance id can be reused after disposal (remount)
tracked points move continuously at 60 fps in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 (no teleport)
attached pairs coincide during their attachment windows (all ratios)
every IK target is within arm reach on every frame in all ratios (hands never stretch off their props)
